contract.law: verbatim_condition (and every optional quote) must be a whitespace-normalized substring of its named source file - prose may paraphrase, this JSON may not (tests/test_temporal_register.py enforces)
contract.scope: the runtime items are the severity/fusion halves ONLY; statically-present conditions were adjudicated at sheet scope in their sprints and their verdicts stand (v10 adjudication law, restated in docs/replay-capture-design.md section 6)

status_semantics.fusion-question: whether discrete tick-level structure fuses/reads correctly at 60 tps - unanswerable on a static sheet by construction
status_semantics.severity-only: the static condition is a banked verdict; runtime measures at-speed severity only and can never soften the banked red
status_semantics.banking-reversal-head: consumes another item's verdict; on FAIL the pre-registered disposition is banking reversal
status_semantics.recorded-not-measured: recorded classes never rendered or measured; not part of the lettered register
